thread:
meera: Heads up 52 UX sync notes: thinking through streaming UI tweaks. Two experiments: (A) inline mini-controls that appear attached to the last message, (B) static composer controls that change state. Which feels less noisy?
dylan: I'm for static composer controls. Inline controls can jump around and are hard for screen reader users.
nora: Inline controls are faster for quick actions (stop/regenerate). But agree on a11y risk. If inline, we should keep the DOM position stable (offscreen focusable element) so keyboard users don't get lost.
evan: Token counter problem: right now itloats on the stream overlay. When the prompt drawer opens it shifts and reflows. Could we make it a chevron icon in the header that expands to show the full count? Keeps a single stable anchor.
pritam: Copy: prefer "Stop" over "Pause". For regenerate, "Regenerate response" is clearer than "Retry". Keep tooltips sentence-case.
nora: Accessibility: use aria-live="polite" for token updates and aria-atomic where we replace the whole count so screen readers read full numbers, not digits. Also announce "response streaming" when a stream starts.
dylan: Perf: don't update visual token count every token. Batch renders to ~200ms and keep precise metrics in backend. Also avoid width jumps by reserving space (min-width) for the badge.
evan: Mobile note: composer controls should be reachable without scrolling the keyboard away. Suggest composer-footer persistent control on small screens, desktop gets inline micro-toolbar.
meera: What about keyboard shortcuts? Suggest Esc to stop when streaming, Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+R to regenerate. Add these to the keyboard shortcuts help panel.
pritam: Visual affordance idea: subtle pulse on the latest token while streaming. If user hits Stop, pulse becomes a static dot. Could help convey progress. Ensure animation is reduced-motion friendly.
nora: Accessibility nit: small token badge on dark theme fails contrast at 12px. Increase color contrast or add a 1px outline. Also provide a high-contrast toggle in settings.
dylan: Edge-case: if a user opens a prompt from the library while streaming we should avoid mounting a second streaming renderer for the same response. De-dupe streams by message id.
evan: Implementation detail: keep streaming DOM separate from stable DOM. Render tokens into a canvas layer or isolated element to avoid layout thrash.
meera: Action items:
- dylan -> keyboard shortcuts doc + stable anchor implementation plan (due Thu)
- nora -> a11y checklist & screen reader scripts (due Fri)
- evan -> mobile footer controls prototype + pulse animation spec (due Wed)
- pritam -> copy microcopy and tooltip strings
I'll set up a quick feature-flagged A/B to ship both patterns and collect engagement metrics. Sync tomorrow 10am PT in #design-review.
